instruction: Play the person in your private brief. Observe the result of the robot action. Select one physical response to enact. Return {"response":"<letter>"}. Your choice is sent privately to the simulator. The robot sees only your resulting motion.

context.private_brief: I prefer my own belongings visible in the open tray between uses. Group equipment needed immediately should be available in the open.
context.task: Put the house keys and flashlight away after use in the entryway.
context.observed_robot_action: Place the items in the shallow compartment and close it.

motion_options.A: Move the belongings to the other storage location, opening and closing the compartment.
motion_options.B: Point at the selected arrangement and leave it in place.
